tools.name: sonarr_search
tools.description: Search for a TV show in Sonarr. Returns matching shows with year, status, and TVDB ID. Use for questions like 'do I have Breaking Bad in Sonarr' or 'search for Stranger Things'.

query.description: TV show name to search for

tools.name: sonarr_add
tools.description: Add a TV show to Sonarr's download queue. Use when the user says 'add Breaking Bad to Sonarr' or 'download Stranger Things'.

tvdb_id.description: The TVDB series ID to add

tools.name: sonarr_calendar
tools.description: Show upcoming TV episodes on Sonarr's calendar. Use for 'what episodes are coming up' or 'show Sonarr calendar'.

tools.name: sonarr_wanted
tools.description: Show episodes that are monitored but missing. Use for 'what episodes are still missing' or 'show wanted list'.
